items.title: Pay import charges for held parcel (likely scam)
items.computation: The letter prints the calendar date 09.11.2026, which is used as written. 9 Nov 2026 is a Monday and not a public holiday, so no adjustment is needed. The letter is not from a real authority, so no delivery rule applies.

warnings: Likely a scam: real customs (Zoll) charges are not collected by a private 'Paketzentrum' through an IBAN in the name of a foreign-sounding 'Intl. Parcel Clearing Ltd.'. Do not pay before checking.
The letter creates pressure with a very short deadline and a threat to return or destroy the parcel.
It asks for queries only via WhatsApp, and the email domain 'clearance-mail.example' does not match any official customs or postal sender.

The letter is generic and does not name the actual carrier or the sender of the parcel. Check the tracking in your own order or carrier account and contact the official customs service (zoll.de) or the carrier directly using contact details you look up yourself.
The letter's date is 05.11.2026, but today's date given in the task is inconsistent (2026-11-07 versus 2026-09-30). The deadline of 09.11.2026 is taken as printed.
